recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the semantic split required by FHIR-32752 in the current SubscriptionTopic source without broadening into unrelated examples or open editorial typo cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-32752 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It noted that server-local search parameter names can vary and that SearchParameter.url is the stable semantic identifier. The accepted resolution made filterParameter required as a human-readable, computation-friendly local name, added filterDefinition 0..1 uri for the canonical SearchParameter URL or other shared filter concept URI, and required modifier support to be consistent with a referenced SearchParameter.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied in 1e09c04ba5a8aea591fa44ca2adef226b1888aed and 365b52222b9aeb872817b317cd6e620955291d56 by making filterParameter 1..1, adding filterDefinition, and adding the modifier rule. 4007af52e0ae46dcc02c846f1ad73dcebc20611f refined related Subscription.filterBy wording. The remaining problem was that the SubscriptionTopic filterParameter ElementDefinition still said the filterParameter itself could be the canonical SearchParameter URL.
additional_context: SubscriptionTopic is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current build maps old top-level canFilterBy paths to SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy after later trigger refactoring. The SubscriptionTopic narrative already explains that filterParameter is a context-local name and filterDefinition links it to a canonical or other complete definition. FHIR-35842 is the same change family and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-50618 is a later unresolved typo tracker in the same narrative area and was not decided.
reconciliation: Updated source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml to define filterParameter as a context-local name used by Subscription.filterBy.filterParameter, and updated the checked-in SubscriptionTopic SVG tooltip so the rendered diagram does not retain the stale canonical-URL wording.
source_changes: source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml: changed SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.filterParameter definition from canonical-URL wording to context-local filter name wording.
source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic.svg: updated the filterParameter tooltip to match the corrected ElementDefinition.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Subscription.filterBy.searchParamName to filterParameter so Subscription instances reference the SubscriptionTopic filter name consistently; already represented on the combined branch.
Moved SubscriptionTopic canFilterBy under trigger, making SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy the current authoritative path for the FHIR-32752 elements.
Triaged unresolved typo issue in the same Filter Definition narrative area; it was not a final decision and was not reconciled here.
